# WCS converter regression tests -- pipe-delimited
# Fields: name | input | reference | encoding | attrs | compare_mode
# compare_mode (6th column) selects how output is compared to the reference:
#   blank    = strict: FITS encodings byte-exact; NATIVE-family <=4-ULP per
#              numeric token. The default -- keep comparisons tight.
#   astequal = relax numeric tokens to AST's astEQUAL tolerance (the Rust
#              equivalent of the C oracle's astEqual). Use only for cases whose
#              last bits are platform dependent, e.g. cancellation-amplified
#              geodetic altitude (OBSALT from OBSGEO-X/Y/Z).
# There is no mode that skips the comparison. A native case whose FITS-read
# path is not yet byte-exact with C is named in the harness's
# NATIVE_READ_EXCLUDED list, which records the reason per case.
#
# The .native reference files were captured from C AST on x86-64 Linux, and
# some of them are not reproducible on another architecture by *any*
# implementation: C AST built and run on arm64 macOS does not reproduce them
# either. Two mechanisms drive that:
#   - FMA contraction. clang contracts `a*b+c` to a single fused multiply-add
#     on arm64, where baseline x86-64 has no FMA instruction to contract to.
#     In ERFA's geocentric->geodetic solution the altitude is a difference of
#     two ~6.4e6 m quantities, so one fused rounding lands ~900 ulp out in the
#     ~4.1e3 m result (still 2e-13 relative).
#   - libm. sin/cos/atan2 are not correctly rounded and differ by an ulp or so
#     between Apple's libm and glibc, which shows up in rotation-matrix
#     elements and in the near-zero residues left where they cancel.
# Cases affected by either are marked astequal here. That mirrors the C
# harness, which marks the same fixtures SKIP_STRING_COMPARE in its own
# wcsconv_tests.txt and registers only the astEqual test for them.
timj_fits-wcs       | timj.ast                       | timj.fits-wcs      | fits-wcs  | cdmatrix=1,FitsDigits=8          |
timj_fits-iraf      | timj.ast                       | timj.fits-iraf     | fits-iraf | FitsDigits=8                     |
timj_fits-aips      | timj.ast                       | timj.fits-aips     | fits-aips | FitsDigits=8                     |
timj_fits-pc        | timj.ast                       | timj.fits-pc       | fits-pc   | fitsrounding=0,FitsDigits=8      |
timj_native         | timj.ast                       | timj.native        | native    | FitsDigits=8                     | astequal
